rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial choice for a person, object, or machine that is run-down and no longer in good condition.

example.english: That old computer is really worn-out; it crashes as soon as I open a few programs.
example.traditional: 部舊電腦真係殘，開幾個程式就死機。
example.jyutping: bou6 gau6 din6 nou5 zan1 hai6 caan4 hoi1 gei2 go3 cing4 sik1 zau6 sei2 gei1

rows.note: Use this for a person or animal that is exhausted from exertion, rather than merely old or physically worn.

example.english: After playing a soccer match, I was so worn-out that I didn't even want to walk up the stairs.
example.traditional: 踢完場波，我攰到連樓梯都唔想行。
example.jyutping: tek3 jyun4 coeng4 bo1 ngo5 gui6 dou3 lin4 lau4 tai1 dou1 m4 soeng2 haang4
